description: Human-reviewed allowlist of documented key-material aliases: clusters of KIDs in .well-known/atlasent-verifier-keys.json that intentionally share identical public-key material. Every cluster listed here MUST have every member revoked=true — an active member sharing material with anything is always a hard failure regardless of this file (see scripts/verify-trust-root-integrity.mjs classifyDuplicateMaterial). Add an entry here only after confirming the sharing is intentional/historical, never to silence a validator failure on a real collision.

entries.reason: Pre-tenant-adoption placeholder KIDs seeded to validate the schema/publish pipeline before real tenant keys existed. Not attestations of any environment's signing identity. All three are revoked.
